our_interpretation: The checkable core is whether the Grok 4 launch results establish declining marginal tool-free HLE accuracy gains from additional training resources.
Diminishing returns requires a specified resource scale. A curve's appearance without defined horizontal units does not determine the marginal return.
Pure scaling requires separating resource increases from changes in algorithms, data composition, reinforcement learning and inference effort.
The benchmark ceiling is the ordinary measurable reading of peak possible performance. Superintelligence has no operational definition here and cannot be inferred directly from an HLE score.
The target is the Grok 4 launch evidence discussed in the July 13 post.
criteria.support_condition: A controlled series underlying the launch graph shows progressively smaller tool-free accuracy gains per specified increment of training resources, while accuracy remains substantially below the benchmark ceiling.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A comparable controlled series shows sustained or increasing marginal gains over the claimed range. Evidence about reinforcement learning or inference scaling alone does not settle pure pretraining scaling.
